insights.one_liner: French IT consulting giant with a large Dutch office and Utrecht headquarters; an IND recognised sponsor, though global staff numbers fell in 2024.

culture.text: A French IT consulting and technology services company with a large office in the Netherlands.
Huge global employer with about 336,900 staff in 2024, listed on Euronext Paris.

open.text: Capgemini Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Global staff shrank from 357,000 in 2023 to 336,900 in 2024.
Made €22.1 billion revenue and €1.67 billion net profit in 2024.
Extended the lease on its Dutch head office in Utrecht.

worth_knowing.text: Sold its US government unit after criticism over its contract with ICE.
An attacker claimed a cyberattack on Capgemini.
